sicht.symbol.hinweis: appears in front of the name in the library
sichtrechte.wer-die-ansicht-in: Who sees the view in the Library (R) and gets “+ New” there (C). Whether a folder is readable is still governed by the {b}. In admin mode the rules don’t apply.
sichtrechte.diese-regeln-kommen-von: These rules come from the parent views and apply here first. They can only be changed there.
sichtrechte.gilt-solange-keine-regel: Applies as long as no rule says otherwise. Sub-views inherit it.
sichtrechte.kommen-nach-den-geerbten: Come after the inherited ones and can only restrict further (✗): a permission applies here only if it applies to the parent view and no own rule withdraws it.
sichtrechte.von-oben-nach-unten: From top to bottom: every matching rule sets its ✓ and ✗; “Stop” ends the check. Conditions only exist on the user.
sichtrechte.trifft-die-regel-zu: If the rule matches, the following ones are not checked.
sichtrechte.was-ein-benutzer-an: What a user may do with this view – even with unsaved rules
sichtrechte.sieht-ein-benutzer-diese: Does a user see this view, and do they get “+ New”? The rules are checked as they stand above, together with the inherited ones.
sichtrechte.waehle-einen-benutzer-das: Pick a user – the result appears immediately.
sichtrechte.ist-administrator-fuer-ihn: {b} is an administrator – the rules don’t apply to them, they see everything.
sichtrechte.die-ansicht-fehlt-in: – the view is missing from their tree, its folders also from the parent views.
sichten.liegt-jetzt-auf-der: “{n}” is now at the top level and no longer inherits permissions; only its own apply.
sichten.erbt-jetzt-die-berechtigungen: “{n}” now inherits the permissions of “{name}”: default {wert}{wert2}. Its own default and the ✓ in its rules no longer take effect.
sichten.was-die-ablage-links: What the Library offers on the left: folder types, conditions and the order as a tree.
sichten.zum-ordnen-am-griff: To arrange, drag by the handle ⠿: between two views or onto a view (it becomes a sub-view).
sichten.noch-keine-ansichten-ohne: No views yet. Without a view, folders only appear under “To do” and via references.
sichten.trefferliste-fehlt-zeigt-die: Result list missing – shows the default list
sichten.ihre-unteransichten-ruecken-eine: Its {anzahl} sub-view moves up one level.
Its {anzahl} sub-views move up one level.
sichten.name: Name
sichten.steht-in-der-ablage: Shown in the Library above the list.
sichten.erst-speichern: Save the view first – then the order can be changed.
sichten.nach-dem-speichern-erbt: After saving, the view inherits the permissions of “{wert}”.
sichten.nach-dem-speichern-erbt-2: After saving, the view no longer inherits permissions.
sichten.dazu-kommen-die-mappen_one: Plus the folders of its {anzahl} sub-view.
sichten.dazu-kommen-die-mappen_other: Plus the folders of its {anzahl} sub-views.
sichten.ohne-mappentyp-dient-sie: Without a folder type it only groups sub-views.
sichten.mappen-dieser-mappentypen-zeigt: The view itself shows folders of these folder types. {wert} If it shows several folder types, there is no “+ New”; as columns it only offers what all folder types have in common.
sichten.auch-kuenftige-z-b: Future ones too, e.g. for “Favourites” with the condition “is my favourite”.
sichten.ohne-mappentypen-zeigt-die: Without folder types the view shows the system columns (title, type, created, changed).
sichten.bei-mehreren-mappentypen-gibt: With several folder types there are only lists that all folder types have, and in them only the shared columns; title and type always come first.
sichten.welche-spalten-die-liste: Which columns the list in the Library shows. You set up the result lists on the folder type.{wert}
sichten.keine-einfache-liste-mit: none – simple list with title and two fields
sichten.hat-frist-in-den: has a deadline in the next days
sichten.bedingungen-gelten-fuer-die: Conditions apply to the view’s own folder types – pick at least one above.
sichten.bei-mehreren-mappentypen-gibt-2: With several folder types there are only fields and tabs that all folder types have alike, and the system values. A shared tab counts per type over that type’s own sources.
sichten.die-ansicht-zeigt-nur: The view only shows folders that meet {b} conditions. Values such as “today” or “current user” are recalculated every time it opens.{wert}
sichten.alle-datumsfelder-die-eine: all date fields that are a deadline
sichten.ist-dieses-feld-leer: – if this field is empty, the condition doesn’t apply.
